task: use a connector in a chat or project

families.label: Toggle connectors per conversation from the chat "+" menu

variants.label: "+" button > Connectors > enable/disable for this conversation
preconditions: the connector is already added and connected
steps: Click the "+" button in the chat interface
Enable or disable the connectors you want for this conversation

families.label: Ask Claude for the data or action and let it select the connector's tools

variants.label: Microsoft 365: ask a question or request an action, tools chosen automatically
preconditions: the Microsoft 365 connector is connected for the account
steps: Ask Claude a question that requires Microsoft 365 data, or ask it to take an action such as sending an email or updating a file
Let Claude automatically detect and use the necessary tools

claude.note: Both documented paths are written for claude.ai/Desktop without distinguishing them; no other product documents this task.

checked: connectors--custom--remote-mcp ### Enabling connectors in chat (read with surrounding Adding custom connectors and dialog sections)
connectors--microsoft--365 ## Usage (read with Setup requirements, Phase 1/2, and Example queries)
summary: Only undistinguished Claude documents using a connector in chat: a per-conversation toggle in the "+" menu, or automatic tool selection.
open_questions: The Microsoft 365 Usage record (P2a) never switches a connector on for the conversation; it was kept because Claude calls the connector's tools while answering, but a stricter reading of T-007's outcome would move it to NEW ("ask Claude to use a connected connector").
Neither record names claude.ai versus Claude Desktop, so P1a/P2a could not be split across claude-web and claude-desktop.
No record covers the project half of the task (enabling a connector for a project), so whether the project path differs from the chat path is unsettled.
